title.narrative: Leveraging Local Capacity to Strengthen Health Service Delivery Project (LLCAP) - Human Resources for Health (HRH1)

description.narrative: (Malawi): USAID's Leveraging Local Capacity to Strengthen Health Service Delivery Project-Human Resources for Health (HRH#1) is an integrated health activity designed to improve the number and availability of well-trained, highly-skilled, and equitably distributed healthcare workers. The activity will support the delivery of quality health services in line with the National Health Sector Strategic Plan and will advance the Government of Malawi's universal health coverage to improve the health status of Malawians...Implemented by the Global Aids Interfaith Alliance (GAIA), the activity will: 1) increase the number and availability of trained personnel and qualified health workers in priority health areas; 2) improve the quality of health services through enhancing staff capacity in pre-service and in-service education; and 3) strengthen the capacity of the Government of Malawi to effectively monitor and regulate health care service providers in the country, including data collection, analysis, and interpretation for evidence based decisions. To achieve the stated objectives, the activity will provide pre-service scholarships for nurses and midwives; recruit and provide salaries for newly graduated nurses and midwives; and provide clinical mentors for training institutions and hospitals. GAIA will support higher institutions to develop curriculum to train healthcare workers to respond to health needs during and after climate related emergencies. GAIA is a local organization and through this mechanism USAID enhances local institutional capacity that will ensure program continuity after the activity closes out...The activity enhances Malawi's pathway to locally led development and aligns with the Integrated Country Strategy Mission Objective 3.2 - Malawi improves access to and quality of health services so that more of its citizens gain and retain full health and can contribute productively at home, in the community, and at work......
